title: Standard opens of Proj: basis, intersections, inclusions and coverings
statement:
Let $S= igoplus_{n\ge0}S_n$ be an $\mathbf N$-graded commutative ring and $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], the set of homogeneous primes $\mathfrak p\subseteq S$ with $S_+
ot\subseteq\mathfrak p$; for $f\in S$ homogeneous of positive degree let $D_+(f)=\{\mathfrak p\in X: f
otin\mathfrak p\}$ (a *standard open*), and $S_{(f)}$ the degree-zero part of $S_f$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], with the canonical homeomorphism $D_+(f)\cong\operatorname{Spec}S_{(f)}$. Then: (0) the standard opens form a basis of the topology of $X$, and $D_+(f)\cap D_+(g)=D_+(fg)$ for $f,g$ homogeneous of positive degree; (1) for $f,g$ homogeneous of positive degree, $D_+(g)\subseteq D_+(f)$ if and only if $g^e=af$ for some $e\ge1$ and some homogeneous $a\in S$ (necessarily of degree $e\deg g-\deg f$ when $af
eq0$); in this case $f$ is a unit of $S_g$ and $f^{\deg g}/g^{\deg f}$ is a unit of $S_{(g)}$; (2) every open covering of a standard open $D_+(f)$ can be refined to a finite covering $D_+(f)= igcup_{i=1}^nD_+(g_i)$ by standard opens; (3) for $g_1,\dots,g_n\in S$ homogeneous of positive degree, $D_+(f)\subseteq igcup_iD_+(g_i)$ if and only if the elements $g_i^{\deg f}/f^{\deg g_i}\in S_{(f)}$ generate the unit ideal of $S_{(f)}$.

proof.text: For a point in an arbitrary basic neighbourhood D(r), choose a homogeneous component r_i outside its prime. The affineOpenCover provides a positive-degree homogeneous h outside that prime. Then D(r_i h) contains the point and lies in D(r); its degree i+deg(h) is positive. This proves the positive-degree basis.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00JP (label lemma-topology-proj) (3), (4), (5) and their proof

proof.text: Pull an arbitrary family D(g_i) back through awayι_f using the preimage formula. Since opensRange_awayι is D(f), D(f) is contained in the union exactly when the pullback is top. PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff makes this equivalent to the unit-ideal criterion. Specialize to a singleton family to obtain that f^k/g^d is a unit in S_(g).

source.place: Constructions, proof of Lemma 01M4 (label lemma-standard-open), first paragraph, proof of (1)(a); Algebra, Lemma 00JP (label lemma-topology-proj) (6) and Lemma 00E0 (label lemma-Zariski-topology)

proof.text: Map the unit f^k/g^d into the ordinary localization S_g and multiply by the unit g^d to obtain that f^k, hence f, is a unit. IsLocalization.algebraMap_isUnit_iff gives g^n=f*b. Put e=n+d+1 and replace b by b*g^(d+1); then e>0 and e*k>=d. Apply DirectSum.decompose in degree e*k and coe_decompose_mul_of_left_mem_of_le to obtain g^e=f*a, where a is the homogeneous component in degree e*k-d.

source.place: Constructions, proof of Lemma 01M4 (label lemma-standard-open), first paragraph, proof of (1)(a) and (1)(b) ('Write the inverse of $f$ in $S_g$ as $a/g^d$ ... replace $a$ by its homogeneous part ... $g^e=af$')

proof.text: Conversely g^e=a*f with e>0 implies D(g)=D(g^e)=D(a) intersect D(f), hence the inclusion. The unit assertions follow from the chart and ordinary-localization arguments above, without constructing explicit inverses or separating the zero-ring case. If a*f is nonzero, DirectSum.degree_eq_of_mem_mem applied to a*f=g^e gives l+d=e*k, hence l=e*k-d.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01M4 (label lemma-standard-open) (1)(a),(b),(c) and its proof (the map $b/f^n\mapsto a^nb/g^{ne}$)

proof.text: For each point of D(f), choose a member of the given cover and a positive-degree basic neighbourhood within it using the basis. Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen gives compactness of D(f), so IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover supplies finitely many of these neighbourhoods. Reindex their finite set by Fin n using Fintype.equivFin. They cover D(f), and each lies in a given cover member, hence also in D(f).

proof.text: Apply the arbitrary-family chart unit-ideal criterion from step 3 to the finite family indexed by Fin n. This is exactly the stated finite covering criterion.
